marketing_description: The DeWALT DW088CG Cross Line Laser features a self-leveling design and projects two green beams, allowing for accurate layout and leveling. This laser has a working range of 100 ft without a detector and 330 ft with a detector, and provides an accuracy of +/-1/8 in at 30 ft. It is powered by two AA alkaline batteries and has an IP54 rating.
